services.name: Birthday Party
services.desc: Celebrate your Birthday in style in one of NOOR’s elegant event spaces. Whether you’re turning 8 or 80, we can help you plan the perfect celebration. Our most popular birthday party venue is the stunning Ella Ballroom, ideal for intimate gatherings with a capacity of 120 guests for banquets and 250 for cocktail receptions. The Ella Ballroom/Banquet Hall features a state-of-the-art sound system and enhanced LED lighting, plus separate bar & foyer area and outdoor patio. For bigger events, choose the magnificent Sofia Ballroom/Banquet Hall , capable of seating up to 320 guests and accommodating up to 600 for cocktail parties.
